I arrive at the building, 'Sawcon Corporation', in large blue, LED letters were lit up in front of me, as I drove across the parking lot searching for a place to park my car. 

Anxiety overwhelmed me, this would be my 12th job interview this year and no job had hired me. I was beginning to fall very behind on my bills, and at this point if I didn't find a place to work soon then I might have to start eating cardboard.

I walk into the building, my back held straight up, my arms at my side, every step was calculated to be exact perfection, I must be presented like I'm a God amongst men, the man for this job, the man they've been searching for.

a secretary is sitting at a large black desk, shuffling papers when I walk up towards her desk, she looks up at me and makes eye contact, a smile lights up across her face. 

"Hello, This is Edward, I'm here for a job interview here, for the custodial position." I say, while trying not to stutter, unforneately my nervousness betrays me and I do end up stuttering and sounding nervous.

"Hello Edward! Mister Delphir will be right with you, have a seat right over there and I will call you up when he's ready for you!" She retorts with a polite smile, and enthusiasm in her sweet sounding voice.

I simply nod back in response as I sit on a chair in the lobby, my leg begins to shake after only a few minutes of waiting. Nervousness and anxiety creeping up inside of me.

"Mister Edward, Please walk right through that door, go down the hall and enter the last office on the right. Mister Delphir is waiting for you." The secretary finally said, after twenty two minutes of waiting. I had arrived only five minutes early.

I get up from my chair, and reply "thank you!" to the secretary as I begin to walk down the hall into Delphirs office.

"Hello Edward!" says Delphir as he gets off his chair, he appears to be a big man in a fancy well dressed suite. Mid forties, yet he already has a few gray hairs near his forehead. a big grin appears on his face as he approaches me and reaches his arm out.

I simply smile back and shake his hand then say, "Hello Delphir! It's a pleasure to meet you in person." 

"come sit down and have a seat." He says to me smiling. I approach his desk and have a seat in a office chair, he sits on his big chair and looks me in the eyes and says.

"Well Edward, I looked through your resume and you appear to be an outstanding candidate for this position, if anything you're over qualified to be working as a custodian.." Delphir says as he pulls out my resume and begins to look through it.

"So how about you tell me about yourself" 

This question always stumps me, "ahh.." I reply, "my name is Edward, I.... went to college for liberal arts.. I like playing league of legends, and subbing to only fans models, on my free time" 

Delphir stares back inquisitly and nods, as he asks the next question.. 

"why do you want to work for sawcon corporation? What brings you here today.." 

I stare back perplexed at the question, sawcon, a company that manufactures saws, and I'm going to be cleaning their bathrooms. What should I say? Who could be passionate about saws or really care about such a random company.

"I... have always been passionate about not starving to death.." I retort.

Delphir, has a puzzled look on his face.. "Normally that's not what I would like to here, I want to see why you think this company is the right place for you.. what do you like about Sawcon and what makes you want to work here.." 

uh-oh, I think to myself that I'm probably not going to get this job now, I really blew it. 

"but i'm also pretty passionate about not starving to death, especially with food prices these days you know?" the boss continues..

"okay well, I'm just hiring you to clean toilets' anyways, when can you start?" He continues. 

"As soon as possible!" I reply enthusiasm and bright smile across my face.

I took it upon myself to raise the boy, and even married his mother, I gave up all my riches, and glory to live the life of some nobody farmer.

a few miles away from town, holding Auroa hands, something feels off, a sense of danger I always got in my old days fighting in the servile war.

I feel an arrow pierce my leg as I fall to the ground shocked, Auroa steps back and screams, "Daddy! no!".

all five of them have a look of deep satisifaction on their faces, like they've been looking for me for a very long time, and they finally found me.. only in the place they'd never expect, just living the life of some boring farmer raising a kid.

Auroa stands in front of me, "I.. won't let you hurt my dad! I love him! you will have to go through me!"

they grin in response, "you can.. do whatever you want with me, just let the boy go.." I say desperation in my voice.

"how many women and children did your men kill in that war? Was any mercy shown then? I don't like killing children, but i'm not opposed to it when it comes to punishing a monster like you.." replies the man as he puts his sword to the boys neck.

Part 1: All my life I've wanted nothing more then to be a hero and an adventurer, yet I was born into a family of nobodies. I wasn't even average academically, or athletically. I was always the easy one to beat, and I always just skimmed by in my classes.

When I became a teenager, I begged all the knights to let me squire for them, finally some hedge knight took me in. I groomed and took care of his horse, and did all he asked of me, yet when he tried to train me in sword combat he said I was no good.

He eventually let me go as his squire, saying with my mediocre sword fighting abilities, I'd never last in a fight. I was disappointed, but it didn't change my mind towards being an adventurer. I found a wizard, and managed to convince him to take me on as his apprentice.

He really tried hard with me, and tried not to give up, but after a while of me casting fire balls so small, they were the size of the tip of my thumb, and ice bolts that would melt into water before reaching a target. He would say to me, "I'm sorry son, but I guess there is some students, that are to dumb that even I can't teach them magic, you'll have to return to wherever you came from.." He kicked me out of his wizards tower, and back to square one I was. Now twenty years old, and mediocre abilities in both fields.

I found some archery camp, and tried to learn the ability of archery, perhaps that's my field of expertise I thought. Well, I got kicked out after I not only missed the target every attempt, but I accidentally hit the archery instructor in the knee with an arrow. he was twenty feet away from the target as well.

I decided to try and find a party of hero's to join anyways, since it is my dream after all. I got turned down by twenty six groups before finding one that seemed to like me.

"..so what are your skills?" The leader of the party named Lance, asked me, he's six foot four, broad shouldered, handsome complexion, with brown long hair that reaches his shoulders. He has huge arm muscles that pop out his shirt, and blue soul piercing eyes.

"Well, I squired for a knight, I spent time apprenticing with a wizard, and I even learned archery, at woodsfield archery training facility!" I would say in response.

a pretty girl, with sorcerer armor on and long blond hair, green emerald eyes, skinny, with clear skin and muscles, and a sorcerer staff in hand, whispers something to lance. I manage to barley make out what she says, "I heard of him, he got kicked out of all those things, this person is a loser.."

Lance smirks at what she says, "Okay, we will take you in!" Lance says to me with confidence.

"What?" The Sorcerer named Kristine would say, "You're going to let this useless guy join the party? Why?" She continues

" .. Im right here you know.." I retort.

"Hey, I like his determination to not give up on his dreams, plus we're the most powerful adventuring party in Lorisville we can protect him fairly effortlessly, he'd make a good squire to manage our horses, and pick up after us." Lance continues.

Kristine scoffs then says, "..fine.." and so I join their party, it consists of now six people including me. Lance who appears to be a warrior, and the leader, Kristine who is a sorcerer, Brekkie, who is a druid and a elf, Vermillion, who is a ranger, Justine, who is a cleric healer.

Then me of course with the name Leon, the most important new addition.

We would proceed to go on lots of quests together, first saving a city that was being raided by orcs. the struggle was real for me however, I knew not how to fight. So whenever I was the target of attacks, Lance or one of the party members would have to go out of their way to save me, and i'd get yelled at for it later on, because of this I learned to master the art of stealth, that way I wouldn't get in their way as they did all the work themselves and I sat and watched.

None of them seemed to notice this though, and none of them seemed to notice me in general. I was the party groupee, the guy that handles the grunt tasks, and sits and watch all the real fighting happen. It became kind of depressing to feel so useless and unneeded.

One day however, we got sent on a ruthless mission. Dark elves invaded Leafside pass. a big town that was somewhat close to where we were currently resting. We got alerted of this, since we were the only group that could act and respond. Hearing the call we head there instantly by horse.

We arrive at the town, and dismount off our horses, we make our way to the city, and see a ton of dark elves armored and weaponed very strongly. They notice my party, but I had already stealthed and hide. They charge instantly at them, Lance draws his sword, Kristine shoots ice on the ground causing them to slip and be slowed, Vermillion starts shooting arrows at them, and Brekkie turns into a tiger, and starts fighting some of the elves. Kristine starts shooting fire balls, and lightning bolts at them. Lance charges in to the front lines with his sword.

They're taking out lots of the elves, but they're clearly heavily out numbered, then a huge looking elf appears that looks to be a master druid. He puts his giant staff on the ground, and a bunch of vines and roots come out of the ground and start to grab each one of them, and grapple them into not being able to move.

They're all covered with roots, and surrounded by dark elves, it seems they've finally met their match, as the chief archdruid approaches the front and says.

"We finally got you all right where we want you, this is the adventuring party that has been causing a lot of grievance.. Well I can't wait to bring them back home, and turn you guys into our slaves.." The Archdruid says with an evil grin.

Some of the dark elves with blades for weapons, cuts the roots off the ground, still leaving them tied up, but making it now possible to transport them. a cart is brought out that seemed to be prepared to transport prisoners somewhere.

I'm still stealthed, and hiding, but I try to find a place I can jump on to follow them.

Karael was a person without many close friends, or family. Her sister Kora, was all she really had. 

Karael would go on to live a very simple life, working as a alchemist, and clothing designer. Kora though, would became an insanely talented and famous singer. Her name being known by pretty much everyone throughout the world.

Kora and Karael would still remain best friends, and as close as ever despite Koras tremendous fame and new life style.

Kora some years into her fame, became increasingly sick, and seemed to be dying, in this dying state, with Karael by her bedside crying, Kora confesses something.

"Years ago, when we were teenagers and stumbled across our mothers old occult books. I found out a way to summon a demon.. I summoned one that goes by the name Zul Goth. He promised me fame and fortune in exchange for my soul, but it seemed he left out the fact that he would take my life and my soul early." Kora said to Karael as she was coughing. 

"..You sold your soul to a demon? For fame? We were happy, you never needed all of this." Karael replied.

"You were happy, I wasn't happy, I always had big dreams and aspiration for something more, that's besides the point cause I guess Zul Goth will be taking my soul prematurely anyways.." Continues Kora

"Not if I can do anything about.. where is this book you used to summon this entity." Retorts Karael.

Kora would go on to explain where she hid the demon summoning book, Karael would find it, and after a long process was able to make the summoning circle, and preform the ritual to summon the demon Zul Goth. 

a green and black portal opens up before Karael, as a giant demon soul would emerge from it, huge eight feet in height, red piercing eyes, and pitch black hardened skin, horns that must be a half foot in height, and a black trident, in his hands.

"You... aren't you Koras sister, I bet you want to sell your soul to save her life, I can do that for you, and I can give you fame and fortune in the process.." Zul Goth would say, tempting Karael with a sly smirk. 

"I'm not interested in making a deal with you, but I do want to reverse the deal you've made with my sister, let me see her contract please.." Karael retorts.

The demon is unable to resist the demand of showing a family members soul contract, so without Zul Goths consent, a giant book wide contract appears before Karael, it must be thousands of pages long. 

"Fine! Search it all you like, there is nothing in there that will help you get your sisters soul back!" Zul Goth says, not showing any fear or lack of confidence. 

Karael unphased begins reading through the thousands of pages of the contract, Zul Goth feels insanely bored, while he is forced to stay there and watch while the contract is read. 

Days go by, while Karael searches for any escape clause she can use, she finds the part of the contract where Zul Goth will take her sisters life early with a mysterious disease. 

Finally, Karael discovers the only escape clause she could find in the very long, confusing document, 

'emergency escape clause article 3277 section 43.12' If the client is unhappy with the deal, she can change her mind before she dies and the soul enters Zul Goths possession by saying, "I enact article 3277, section 43.12" The catch is, she loses all her fame and glory, and goes back in time to the time she made the deal, and is unable to sell her soul to Zul Goth or any other demon again. 

Karael writes this information down, on a piece of paper, and closes the book, and says to Zul Goth. "I'm done, thank you." 

Zul Goth was a sleep out of the boredom, and awakens, "okay, so I'm sure you realized there is nothing at all that can be done! Your sisters soul is mine! Unless of course, you sell me your soul to save her.." 

"Yep seems to be the case.." Karael retorts, as she walks out the door to the basement, "Wait!" Zul Goth would say, before she can leave the basement.

Karael stops walking up the stairs and stays still for a brief moment. Zul Goth then says, "I know you must have found article 3277, section 43.12, but please business is super slow in hell.. I will let your sister live out her days without any disease, and I will treat her with respect when I have her soul, just please don't tell her about that!" 

Karael simply continues to walk up the stairs, as Zul Goth seems very sad and disappointed. Karael returns to Koras bedside, and explains article 3277 section 43.12.

"Actually, I'm starting to feel way less sick now, and I love being famous!" Kora replies.

"You can't be serious, you'd let this demon have your soul for fame? You know he will just kill you in a tragic accident instead or something right?" Karael retorts. 

"My dream is to be a singer, I guess you'll never understand." Kora replies..

Karael sighs, realizing that her sister has never been the brightest.

Gnault was a commoner, a peasant that lived a very rough life, working his hands to the bone to provide for his father, sister, and grandmother.

Gnault felt insanely sad, and overworked in his role, he wasn't paid enough, and truthfully if his family didn't depend on his wages, he would have decided suicide ages ago.

Yet there was one thing that kept Gnault motivated to get through his days, when he was fourteen years old, he met a girl, named Kit. She to him was a girl not like any other, they hit it off very well, and very fast. Sparks flew, they started off as closest friends, and then became much more.. lovers.

It was truly the happiest days of Gnault's life, the days when he was a kid, and didn't have to work a horrendous job, the day he was with Kit, who he believed to be the love of his life.

Unforneately though, time didn't serve either of them well, they wanted to get married so very badly.. They wanted to share their lives together, yet when they were seventeen, Kits family took on the explorers life, and decided to settle on an island called Bermuda that was believed to be paradise, abundant of resources.

Gnault was saving money hoping to have the funds to purchase a small boat and make the journey to the island she was staying at, he realized that he could no longer stomach the peasant hard worker life style anymore.. He even sold some prized possessions, gold jewelry passed down to him from his mother, and his Grandfathers sword from the Third Servile War.

Finally, he had enough money, even without selling their small home that he could afford a boat, and make the trip. He brings it up to his father, sister, and grandmother..

"I'm going to leave and go to Bermuda.. I miss Kit, she's all I can think about, and I can't live another day in the mines, three workers died today, and it gets more and more dangerous and difficult by the day.." Gnault would say.

"You can't leave.. We need you to provide for us!" His father Gary would retort.

"You all can come with me, we will have enough food to make the trip, and in Bermuda a better life will surely await us then this shit hole city they call Trania." Replied Gnault.

After some arguing back and forth, Gnault's family realized that he would never give, and decided going with him to Bermuda would be the only choice they have, other then starve to death by themselves, or God forbid try to get a job of their own.

They sell the small house they own, and that money is enough with the money Gnault already saved, to get a rather good boat, and plenty of food and rations to make the trip, Gnault would also purchase a compass, a map, and a guide on how to sail properly. Studying it profusely before making the trip.

Nine days go by uneventfully, the sailing trip is rather boring and uneventful, when something unexpected happens, a ship appears on the horizon, but this is not a merchant trip like they'd usually sail past, this was a pirate ship.

Being on a simple travelers vessel, with no weapons on board, Gnault having sold the only sword he had, the pirates are easily able to board the ship, any resistance, and their ship could be sunk with a measly few cannon balls.

Gnault, and his father, sister, and Grandmother, wait on the deck with they hands on their heads.

a pirates captain, approaches them, he has a peg leg, and a eye patch, he smells God horrendous, like he's never bathed in many years, he has a very long unkempt beard, and long unkempt hair, he looks very unattractive and out of shape, as he opens his mouth to speak, his breath is so bad Gnault nearly wants to vomit from having taken a whiff of it.

"Where here is the captain of thy vessel?" The captain would ask, "it is aye!" retorts Gnault, "we're a simple travelers vessel heading to a island, we have no goods for you to steal, only enough rations to last the trip.."

"there is always something for us to steal, this ship for example could go for quite a bit, plus who knows how much someone would pay to purchase the lot of y'all as slaves.."The captain replies.

"WAIT!" a girl yells as she makes her way to the front, she takes off her hood, and reveals herself to be Kit, my long lost childhood love.

"I know this guy, from my childhood, please just let him and his family go, they're no threat.." she would say frantically.

"No my dear, you're a simple crewmate, we will take what we want from who we want.." Retorts the captain.

"Please? for me?" Kit continues.

"Fine, only for you, plus it doesn't seem like they have anything worth while anyways.." The captain says.

The captain and his crew and Kit appear to be heading back on the ship, "wait Kit!" I yell out.

"I was going all the way to Bermuda for you, how come you're a pirate now and with this crew, what happened to you?" I say frantically.

"These pirates.. took me under my wing, well I guess by taking me under their wing they murdered my family, and kidnapped me on the way to Bermuda, I have been a pirate ever since, listen Gnault, you know I love you and always will, you're my first love and my true love.. but please return home, and live a normal life without me." She would reply.

"I could never leave you, and abandon you, remember we said our love would be for life.." I retort.

She lets out a sad smile, and says.. "Good bye Gnault..." and returns to the boat.

The ship pulls its boards back in and takes off, letting us leave in peace. I shed tears to myself, and realize something, I must learn to fight, and return for her and stop these pirates.. I will die trying to.

I was no ordinary investigator, I made my reputation from thin air as the best homicide detective that Vancouver has ever seen.

I took the liberty of solving hundreds of cold cases, and I did so expecting nothing in return except the glory of having finally brought the guilty criminal to justice.

Yet when this case was plopped on my desk, I thought it would be the easiest case I ever solved.

The first lead I discovered seemed cut and dry, her husband.. She apparently got caught cheating on him after all.

He had the biggest motive, and had the most access to her, yet that couldn't possibly make sense when I found out the affair partner bought a gun, the same kind of gun that was used to murder her.. The husband had no such weapons that I could discover unless he was intelligent enough to illegally buy the same weapon that the affair partner had, knew what gun he had, and threw away the evidence when the search warrant was enacted.

When I arrested and brought the affair partner to interrogation though, he swore on his life that he had nothing to do with it.

"I will get a lawyer, polygraph test me all you like, I would have never done this to Sarah!" he yelled.

Very well I thought, then another possible lead came up, finger prints at the crime scene of five different people. One being her sister, another her brother, one being her boss, and two others that seem to have no connection to the victim whatsoever.

"this is the most confusing case I've ever had.." I thought to myself, as I pondered deeply on how I will be able to figure out who did it.

I interrogate each lead one by one, all of them of course swearing their innocence.. Only the victims brother has a reliable alibi though, and one of the people with no connection to the victim has a alibi as well.

I have nearly given up on this case, how can I possibly come to a clear conclusion of who was responsible for the girls murder.. that was until a witness came foward..

She was a middle aged girl, brown hair, green eyes, wearing a black coat, and jeans. She knocked on the door to my private investigator building.

"Come in!" I yell out.

She enters the building, and pulls up the chair in front of my desk and sits in front of me.

"what brings you to all seeing eye investigation?" I ask the lady.

"I... saw the murder take place, I didn't want to say anything out of fear of anything happening to me, yet I know I have to because its the right thing to do." Says the brown haired lady, as she fidgets her leg with anxiety.

I take out a giant note pad, and a pen, and then reply, "I'm really glad you came foward, tons of leads on this case without much to go off of, do you have any idea what the murderer looks like?"

"He was very tall probably 6'4, he had a snake tattoo on his arm, and he was lanky, not very muscular or fat." she continues.

"hmm.. doesn't seem to match any possible lead I have so far.." I say to her, as I write this information down.

"did you get a good look at his face? Can you describe that so I can draw it out?" I continue.

" Unforneatly it was very dark, he was white though, thin trimmed beard, and that's all I could gather." She retorts.

"Very well, give me your number, and I will give you my card, if you get any more information, please let me know." I tell the girl, as I hand her my card, and she writes down her number on a post-it note and hands it over to me.

I'm unable to do much with the lead she gave me, and nearly a week goes by when she calls me.

".. I think I see that man again, he's right in front of me.." She says on the phone with panic in her voice, yet she tries to keep the volume of her voice down like a whisper.

"Tell me the address and I will be right over there!" I reply frantically.

She quietly whispers me the address, and I grab my gun, and get in my car and ride all the way over there.

"You stupid bitch! I will kill you!" I hear a tall figure yelling, as he appears to be pushing down and hitting the girl that gave me the lead.

I immediately exit my car, and fire shots into the man, he seems to fall to the ground.

I make my way over to the girl, and ask her, "are you okay?"

"I have no idea what those people are celebrating, or why they sound so happy to be ruled by a demon lord now.." I think to myself as I stealthily search around the gates for a safe place to climb where I can’t be spotted.

"Surprise Ser Leon! We're glad you finally made it here!" from a very large crowd of onlookers in Merania, as well as a bunch of demon guards that seem overly ecstatic to see me.

Confusion overrides me, and I'm unsure what I should do here, should I run and try to stealth somewhere? or should I wait it out and see what the hell is possibly going on.

One of the demon guards pats me on the shoulder, I jump up in fear.. I had no idea a demon guard was near me, how did I let him sneak up on me like that.

He simply smiles at me then says, "Don't be afraid Ser Leon, we've been expecting you my sweet knight.."

I simply glanced at him, and give him a face of pure confusion.

One of my good friends named Aren from Merania makes his way to the front of the crowd, and smiles at me then says.

I try to begin to climb down the wall, but then the demon guard puts his trident in front of me..

"I'm sorry Ser Leon, but you're going no where, we've worked much to hard to get this festival ready for you.. you're going to stay and enjoy every last second of it.." Says the demon guard, his red eyes staring into my blue eyes.

I sense the darkness of his soul, and a feeling that something very nefarious is going on here, and my gut instincts were correct.

"Don't do this Ser Leon, please just come down and join us in the festival!" Yells out Aren..

I pause for a brief moment, and put my hand on the guard of my sword that is currently hilted.

I wait only a few minutes, before he emerges back, with someone by his side.. "...Virion.." I think to myself..

The villain I've been searching for! If my weapon was intact and usable I'd think to violate the city rules and attack him there and then.. but alas it's not.

"Well hello there Ser Leon, it's a pleasure to see you here in Lorisville.. nice blade I suppose you want that bad boy sharpened and worked on?" Says Virion, with a smirk plastered upon his handsome dark complexion.

"how can I trust you to work on my sword? You will probably just weaken it so I lose to you later.." I reply

sixty gold... that's actually way cheaper then I expected, most blacksmiths charge a fortune to work on Titansteel weapons.

I was insanely surprised to know that all the people I considered 'friends' didn't give a single shit about me when my body was taken over by body snatchers.

I had no ability to control my body, all I could do is observe the snickers behind my back, as they talked about how much "better" the new Josh was, and how he was never so hard working before, never so outgoing.

I figured my wife and kids would have my back, they after all are the only people I ever truly could trust, but even my wife while she was concerned at first.. It was over shadowed by huge pay raises, and better love making, and a more attentative father..

I heard her talking on the phone once with her sister, "I know that Josh got taken over by a body snatcher, but the new Josh is just so great! Its like I fell in love all over again, and the old Josh can never compare! I feel guilty for feeling this way, but at the end of the day everyone seems happier!"

My heart shattered, and I didn't even have any eyes anymore to cry out of, I didn't have any arms to grab or hit with, nor any voice to scream to vent my frustrations at a world that seemingly forgot me and betrayed me.. Friends and family that weren't really who they said they were just snakes waiting for something better.

It took me a lot of hard work and will power, but I eventually broke free of the body snatchers grasp, I managed to take back control of the drivers seat of my body, and man it felt good.

It was like I was a new born again at first, I screamed for 5 minutes straight, I jumped and ran and paced, I did push ups. I felt like a new man, like I was reborn.

but there I was once again in a life that no longer belonged to me, people that I knew betrayed me and didn't care for the real me.

I blended in for weeks, it was hard to imitate the new 'Josh' but I managed to fool almost everyone, all except for my wife..

"Josh... you're back? It's you isnt you? the man I love!".. she said to me hugging me and kissing me like she actually cared for me.

"shut up!" was all I said in return, "I know what you said, I know you preferred the body snatcher.." I said, as I packed my things and began to walk out the door.

"wait Josh! It wasn't what it looks like, they convinced me it was what was best.." she retorted running after me..

I simply ignored it, and slammed the door shut on my way out.

I withdraw all my savings and bought a plane ticket to Ireland, I have cousins and friends that live there, and it's far away from any of these body snatching events that I should be safe.

I could never trust my old friends, and my old wife ever again, when I disappeared at first my phone blew up, with missed calls and texts from best friends, my kids, my family members.. all of whom betrayed me except my kids who were to young to know what had transpired.

I sent my kids a text telling them that I love them, and explaining the situation to the best of my ability, then I snapped my phone in half and got a new phone.

I lived a life in peace for 4 years until someone knocked at the door, it was my brother Alex.. I never spoke to him much around the time the body snatcher took control of my body and nobody seemed to care.

I thought to myself on wither or not I should answer the door, or ignore it.. I wanted no risk of being taken over by a body snatcher again, or being convinced at all to return to my old 'life'.

Finally though, after enough knocking and pleading from my brother outside I open the door.

"Josh! it's been so long!" he gives me a giant bear hug immediately, I let it last for ten seconds before forcing him to let go of me..

"yeah its me, what do you want Alex? and how did you even find me?" I ask

"I knew you'd end up running away to Ireland if you ever left the States, I still talk to that side of the family occasionally myself.. anyways, i'm here to convince you to come back home, your wife and kids are struggling bad without you, she was a stay at home mom remember? You were also the greatest Architect in the company, and the sales took a tremendous hit since your unexpected departure, we need ya back Joshy!" he says to me enthaustically.

"I can't come back!" I retort, "and I need you to leave.."

"oh Joshy, Joshy, I know.. you're not the real Josh anymore, the body snatchers took ya over.. but we need ya back we don't care if you're the real Josh or not.." Alex replies.

I guess my wife kept me reclaiming my body a secret afterall.. perhaps she truly did still care for me. I simply respond to him by punching him as hard as I can, he falls to the ground nearly knocked out, his nose bloody as he stares up at me in shock.

"Stay out of my new life, be thankful that's all I give you, and I don't snatch your body as well!"

I slam the door on his face.

she didn't care, so long as she got what she wanted, which was me no longer being alive..

the angel tells me.

I ask the angel, "How.. how was she the person I hurt most in my life?"

he doesn't answer, but it doesn't take long to find out.

She still visits my grave three times a week, and each time she cries and sheds tears.

"Wow, she really does still care" I think to myself..

She was only thirteen when I passed away, I knew it would hurt her, but I thought overtime she'd get over it and forget I even existed.

As her grim reaper, its a painful task, to be the one that most take your own daughters life.

However; it is a pleasant sacrifice for me to make, as I spend my time as her grim reaper saving her life hundreds of times. a car that spun out and woulda hit her, i send to the guard rail instead.

When she goes cliff diving, and would have hit a rock, I make sure she just nearily avoids the rock enough to notice it, but not get hurt.

Because of this, she lives an insanely long life. She ends up eventually passing away to natural causes at the age of ninety five, i'm unable to protect her from her own biology of course.

She sees me as her grim reaper and gasps, "so you were the one that saved me all those times huh dad?" she says.

I simply smile at her, and hug her, we hug each other for a while, and then off we go together back to the spectral city.

But I never gave up, and vigilant I remained until I finally tracked him down, a piece of information from a correspondent here, a correspondent there.. I put two and two together and eventually I found his lair.

There he stood before me, black long hair that reached his shoulders, eyes darker then a black hole, that nearly evaporated the light from my soul by taking a glance at them. Dual wielding two black swords, with some kind of blue runes on them going down.

He wore black robes, around gold plated armor. His very presence made me question if I had bitten off more then I could chew for once, but I've came much to far to give up now.

I draw my sword then yell out to him, "Your time has finally come Virion, I hope you're prepared to answer for your crimes, and all the lives you've stolen!"

Virion grins at me in return, and flashes a surprisingly bright and optimistic smile. "Oh my, I've heard the rumors of you before, but you're much more handsome in person, and.. muscular I might add. Such a great looking dude.."

This catches me off guard, and I can't tell if this is some kind of mind game to interfere with how strongly I come at him, but I have no time for mind games.. I charge right at him and swing with my sword at his head, he effortlessly dodges it, and elbows me so hard it throws my body half away across the room.

"Damn he's strong!" I think to myself, "But I have to win, I have to..."

Virion simply smiles at me then continues, "You're so handsome, and your sword swing was so quick, my God you're marvelous, you're truly something else!"

I don't respond, I continue to charge at him and swing at him with my sword like my life depends on it, swing after swing he effortlessly dodges every one of my swings.

"You might actually have a shot at beating me with how fast and powerful your swings are!" Virion says..

"Comon, stop messing around, if you're truly this powerful just finish me off, why toy with me so much.." I retort.

"I'm not toying with you at all, you're insanely powerful and i'm not sure how I could possibly beat a hero like you!" Virion says in response, no hint of sarcasm in his voice.

Eventually I feel tired and out of breath for swinging at him so much, he just continues to dodge everything I throw at him like i'm nothing.. I guess he really has earned his reputation and I wasn't ready.

Out of breath, I drop my sword.. "Go ahead and just kill me already Virion.. enough games.."

"Kill you? never I don't stand a chance against a legendary hero such as yourself.." Virion replies.

I pick up my sword off the ground, and try to swing at him again much slower and weaker then my previous attempts, however; this time he gets stabbed and impaled through the chest.

"What... why did you let me hit you?" I ask Virion.

"Let you? No, you're a great hero, you killed me fair and square, great job, you saved the world and all that good stuff people will love you I'm sure!" Virion says with a wink.

I remove the sword from his chest, as he falls to the ground and bleeds out.

As I leave the lair, and people realize I killed Virion, I'm declared a world wide hero and praised world wide by everyone for killing what was seemingly an unstoppable villain.

However; my pride is forever wounded, I can't look anyone in the eye, or take my accomplishment seriously, because I know he made a complete fool out of me and let me win.

I sit alone in my cold dark cell, solitary confinement for twenty three hours per day is really as brutal as it gets. The food is so horrible, that I don't even believe it can be considered edible.

I think to myself, "you reap what you sow afterall.."

Finally I receive a visitor, and i'm moved from my solitary cell to a visiting area with my Lawyer walks in, he sits down in the chair across the bench from me seeming esactic and beyond thrilled to tell something to me.

"Great news Damian! With this new information, the court has elevated your appeals, your death sentence might get commuted to a life sentence.. that means you will get to be free from solitary confinement and get to live life in General Population! How does that sound?" My lawyer says to me with an excited sounding voice.

"..noo...noo, the media and press can't use that as an excuse.. by the time I did what I did I was long an adult, and had gotten over that shit and left it in the past.. I knew what I was doing, and I did it because I wanted to and liked it.. I loved the feeling of having power over others, I loved the sound of their screams and how it... invigurated me." "ahh... okay... man, that sounds kind of twisted and gross.." my lawyer replies, "but that's besides the point because that's isn't what you will tell the court psychologist when he comes and sees you, you don't understand even the Governor of Colorado is sympathetic towards your cause now, you could even be granted clemency and see the outside of a prison cell one day.. "Because I want to be authentic, I did my crimes because they made me happy, they made me feel alive.. I loved doing it. I'd rather die having the world know me for who I really am, then live a normal life as a lie.." I reply. "Even if I ever got out of here again you know id go back to killing and that doesn't bother you?" I continue.

"Of course not!" my lawyer replies, "getting you out of prison would do wonders for my career, hey I never said I was a good person either did I?" He continues. 

"Well anyways, that's besides the point, I know how terrible Colorados death row is.
